newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains feedlots to price cattle at $68 -trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains feedlots to price cattle at $68 -trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle will likely be priced at $68.00 per cwt next week, up $2.00 from $66.00 trades this week, feedlot sources said.
Most showlists should be smaller than this week's and contain short-fed cattle. Noting the sharp drop in cash beef prices this week, cattle feeders expect steady to lower bids next week.
"We will be asking $68.00, and they will probably be bidding $64.00," said a Texas feedlot manager.
Feedlots are very current with most of this week's sales originally scheduled for late December and early January showlists.
"Our showlist will be a little bigger next week. A lot of them (cattle) should not be on there, but the owners are anxious to sell" a Texas manager said.
He said many of the cattle are short-fed, but owners were anxious to sell as soon as possible before prices fall. CME live cattle futures indicate cattle prices will move lower early next year.
